title: PLACEHOLDER: BC Registries proprietorship registration
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] A sole proprietor trading under a name other than their own legal name registers that name.

title: PLACEHOLDER: BC Registries name request
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] A name approval request comes before registration.

title: PLACEHOLDER: City of Vancouver business licence
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Businesses operating in Vancouver, including home-based ones, need a business licence.

title: PLACEHOLDER: CRA business number
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] A business number is needed before opening a GST or payroll program account.

title: PLACEHOLDER: PST small sellers bulletin
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Small sellers with gross sales at or under the threshold over the past 12 months and no established premises need not register.

title: PLACEHOLDER: PST small sellers bulletin
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Whether a seller has established premises affects the small seller exemption.

title: PLACEHOLDER: CRA GST small supplier
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Registration is required once taxable supplies exceed the small supplier threshold.

title: PLACEHOLDER: CRA voluntary GST registration
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Small suppliers may register voluntarily.

title: PLACEHOLDER: Charging and showing tax
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Registered businesses charge tax and show registration numbers on invoices.

title: PLACEHOLDER: WorkSafeBC employer registration
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Employers register with WorkSafeBC when they hire workers.

title: PLACEHOLDER: CRA payroll account
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Employers open a payroll program account before the first payday.

title: PLACEHOLDER: BC minimum wage
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Employees are paid at least the general minimum wage.

title: PLACEHOLDER: Employment Standards Act, pay statements
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Employers give a written wage statement each payday.

title: PLACEHOLDER: Employment Standards Act, records
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Employers keep payroll records for a required period.

title: PLACEHOLDER: Employee or self-employed
text: [PLACEHOLDER TEXT - NOT AN OFFICIAL SOURCE] Whether a worker is an employee or a contractor depends on the working relationship.
